## European and international research projects

- **HOPE4Kids — Holistic Oncological Palliative Care 4 Europe’s Kids** (2025–2029). EU4Health Programme, European Commission.
- **SAM — Smart Digital Twin for Social Prescribing in Primary Healthcare** (2025–2028). Interreg Sudoe, European Commission.
- **Health4EUkids — Joint Action for Health Promotion and Prevention** (2022–2025). EU4Health Programme, HaDEA.
- **TIMELY — A Patient-Centered Early Risk Prediction, Prevention, and Intervention Platform** (2021–2024). Horizon 2020, Grant Agreement 101017424.
